mapper.select: select c2.c_name as pprBusinessUnitName, c3.c_name as pprReserveCpyName, ppr.ppr_Type as pprType, mn.*, d1.d_name as pprManagerUnitName, d2.d_name as pprManagerDepName, u1.U_Name as pprProjectManagerName, u2.U_Name as pprProjectLeaderName, u3.U_Name as pprEngineerName, u4.U_Name as pprEngineerLeaderName from Pre_Project_Reserve_dtl mn left join sys_department d1 on d1.d_id=mn.ppr_manager_unit left join sys_department d2 on d2.d_id=mn.ppr_Manager_Dep left join sys_company c2 on c2.c_id=mn.ppr_business_unit left join sys_company c3 on c3.c_id=mn.ppr_Reserve_cpy left join Pre_Project_Reserve ppr on ppr.id=mn.ppr_id left join SYS_User u1 on u1.u_id=mn.ppr_project_manager left join SYS_User u2 on u2.u_id=mn.ppr_project_leader left join SYS_User u3 on u3.u_id=mn.ppr_engineer left join SYS_User u4 on u4.u_id=mn.ppr_engineer_leader where mn.ppr_id=#{id}
